result.summary: Round 2, lens market: wrote runs/WF06-20260925-01/crossreview-market.json (sai.idea-crossreview/1). It has 16 items covering every (idea, criterion) of execution and owner_fit exactly once, and each their_score equals round 1. For each item I re-read the other analyst's quotes in the cleaned copies and compared the reasoning with the sources and with my market findings. 15 agree, 1 disagree. Disagreement: owner_fit / 02-sai / no_selling_self 5 -> 4. Reason: 01 got 4, yet 02 carries the same or larger residuals. The 01 source says 'Не нужно доверие к нам лично', which 02 lacks. In 02 the shop sends its customers and their photos to an unknown vendor and pays for the pilot up front. The pilot also needs per-item measurements, and the same kind of manual per-client work cost 01 a point. Four verbatim quotes support this. Agree notes also record non-score remarks: the Advisor rule engine partly transfers to 02 build_fit; the hooks base in 03 does not reach non-programmers; platform risk does not belong to 03 no_selling_self. Self-check: my own script reported 'items 16, expected 16, missing 0, problems 0, disagrees 1'. All three crossreview files existed at check time, so the full stage was validated: `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260925-01 --stage crossreviews` -> 'OK WF06-20260925-01 (stage crossreviews)', exit=0.
